Community rules

Keep the clubhouse welcoming.

Last updated: October 4, 2026.

Who can join

Accounts and online community features are for players aged 13 and older. If your location requires an older age or a parent’s permission, meet that requirement before signing up. Players who are minors should review the terms with a parent or guardian. This is an independent game, not an official school service.

Profiles, maps and fair play

Do not post harassment, threats, hate, sexual content, private information, scams or content you do not have permission to use. Do not impersonate another person, exploit bugs for rewards, use cheats, manipulate rankings or disrupt the service. Keep personal information out of usernames, bios, pictures and map titles.

Trading and lockers

Review the exact items and patterns before accepting a trade. Never share passwords or accept offers to sell accounts, coins or items for money. Lockers use the odds shown before opening; an item is never guaranteed unless specifically stated. All current locker openings use earned game currency or rewards, and items have no cash-out value.

Reports and review

Email room310support@gmail.com with the username, map or incident, and relevant screenshots if available. Do not send passwords or another person’s sensitive information. PolyGolf Staff may remove content or restrict access for rule violations. You may use the same address to request a review of a moderation decision.

Community spaces

Our Room310 Discord has its own server rules and Discord’s age and service requirements. Reports of immediate threats or emergencies should go to appropriate local emergency services.
